conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What distinguishes the brewing process for each of these methods?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Drip coffee uses hot water dripping through grounds, pour-over involves a slow, controlled pour, and espresso machines force pressurized hot water through finely ground coffee.
